### Changes
- Automatic backups now cover **78 hours** of history instead of 36. The app keeps 13 backups, one every 6 hours, which takes up to about 180 MB.
- The status line shows how many hours of history are kept.
- Releases are now built and published by GitHub Actions.

### Install
Download `com.homebrew.loginkeeper_1.0.1_all.ipk` and install it with Homebrew Channel or `ares-install`. If you already use Login Keeper, open the app once after updating so the background job picks up the new script.

### Not tried on a real TV yet
- A wipe made by the TV itself (detection and restore were tested with a simulated wipe)
- Starting up after a TV reboot (the boot hook was run by hand)
- Restoring only some apps right after a wipe (tested offline, not on a live TV)
